[LTAC.2.2.1] The optional `as <expr>` clause declares a
correlation key that drives per-fact supersedure on re-fire per
[LRST]. A new activation with the same
evaluated key supersedes the prior timer; the prior timer's
deferred actions do not fire. Without `as`, each `after` clause
schedules an independent timer that fires regardless of re-fires.
